errors.text_span: около 20 хил. кв. м през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the value in 2014 is around 20 thousand sq. m, but the plot shows it at approximately 25-30 thousand sq. m. The value for 2014 is visually identical to the value for 2017, which the description correctly identifies later as "около 25 хил. кв. м". This creates an internal inconsistency and misrepresents the minimum value.
